## Areas of Interest and Scale of Anomaly

### Kiremt-receiving woredas

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

```

```{r, libraries, echo = FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hide'}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(arrow)
library(scales)
library(readxl)
library(DT)
library(gghdx)
gghdx()

# reading in land mask file
land_mask <- read_csv(
    file.path(
        dirname(
            dirname(
                Sys.getenv("AA_DATA_DIR"))), 
        "Ethiopia", 
        "2024", 
        "Trigger Development", 
        "woreda_land_mask.csv"))

# reading in admin file
eth_adm1_codab <- st_read(
  file.path(
    Sys.getenv("AA_DATA_DIR"),
    "public", "raw", "eth", "cod_ab", "Admin_2024.gdb.zip"), 
  layer = "eth_admbnda_adm1_csa_bofedb_2024")

eth_adm2_codab <- st_read(
  file.path(
    Sys.getenv("AA_DATA_DIR"),
    "public", "raw", "eth", "cod_ab", "Admin_2024.gdb.zip"), 
  layer = "eth_admbnda_adm2_csa_bofedb_2024")

eth_adm3_codab <- st_read(
  file.path(
    Sys.getenv("AA_DATA_DIR"),
    "public", "raw", "eth", "cod_ab", "Admin_2024.gdb.zip"), 
  layer = "eth_admbnda_adm3_csa_bofedb_2024")



# reading in file with seasons from ASAP
eth_seasons <- read_csv(
    file.path(
        dirname(
            dirname(
                Sys.getenv("AA_DATA_DIR"))), 
        "Ethiopia", 
        "2024", 
        "Trigger Development", 
        "seasons_for_woredas.csv"))

jjas_woredas <- eth_seasons %>%
    filter(season1 == "JJAS")

# reading in the lastest forecast
may_forecast <- read_csv(
    file.path(
        dirname(getwd()),
        "data", 
        "eth_forecast_may_2024.csv"))
# EM-DAT
em_dat <- read_excel(
    file.path(
        dirname(getwd()),
        "data", 
        "public_emdat_custom_request.xlsx"))
# CERF Allocations
funding <- read_excel(
    file.path(
        dirname(getwd()),
        "data", 
        "funding_list_country.xlsx"))

# reading in past re-forecast and forecast data
# upto 2016, re-forecasts, from 2017, forecasts
adm3_forecast <- read_parquet("../../TriggerApp2024/data/df_eth_mars_zonal_adm3.parquet")

# filtering for only JJAS forecasts
jjas_forecast <- adm3_forecast %>%
    filter(adm3_pcode %in% jjas_woredas$admin3Pcode & 
               pub_month == 5 & 
               valid_month %in% c(6, 7, 8, 9)) %>%
    mutate(pub_year = year(pub_date)) %>%
    group_by(adm3_pcode, pub_year, pub_month) %>%
    summarise(Seasonal_total = sum(value, na.rm = T))

# Getting the seasonal average over the years
forecast_mean <- jjas_forecast %>%
    filter(between(pub_year, 1993, 2016)) %>%
    group_by(adm3_pcode) %>%
    summarise(Seasonal_average = mean(Seasonal_total, na.rm = T)) %>%
    ungroup()

# the seasonal average
season_ave <- forecast_mean %>% 
    filter(adm3_pcode %in% jjas_woredas$admin3Pcode) %>% 
    summarise(seasonal_average = mean(Seasonal_average, na.rm=T))

# seasonal value for 2024
ave_2024 <- may_forecast %>% 
    filter(admin3Pcode %in% jjas_woredas$admin3Pcode) %>% 
    summarise(country_mean = mean(Seasonal_Forecast, na.rm=T)) %>%
    mutate(pub_year = year(as.Date("2024-05-01")))

```

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#| label: fig-forecast
#| fig-cap: 
#|   - "Woredas with their respective livelihoods"
#|   - "Seasonal forecast by woreda"
#| column: page-inset-right
#| layout-nrow: 1
#| out-width: "100%"


# plotting woredas for JJAS
eth_seasons %>%
    merge(eth_adm3_codab, by = "admin3Pcode") %>%
    merge(land_mask, by = "admin3Pcode") %>%
    mutate(land_mask_jjas = case_when(season1 != "JJAS" ~ NA,
                                      .default = land_mask)) %>%
    ggplot() +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = land_mask_jjas, geometry = Shape)) + 
    geom_sf(data = eth_adm1_codab, fill = "transparent", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_discrete(na.translate = F) +
    labs(title = "Woredas that receive rains during JJAS (Kiremt) season",
         fill = "Land Mask") +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, "cm"), 
          text = element_text(size = 20))

# plotting forecast, anomalies etc
may_forecast %>%
    merge(forecast_mean, 
          by.x = "admin3Pcode", by.y = "adm3_pcode") %>%
    mutate(Anomaly = Seasonal_Forecast - Seasonal_average) %>%
    merge(eth_adm3_codab, by = "admin3Pcode", all.y = T) %>%
    mutate(may_anomaly_jjas = case_when(
        admin3Pcode %in% jjas_woredas$admin3Pcode ~ Anomaly, 
        .default = NA)) %>%
    ggplot() +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = may_anomaly_jjas, geometry = Shape)) + 
    geom_sf(data = eth_adm1_codab, fill = "transparent", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "tomato", mid = "white", 
                         high = "#0f52ba", midpoint = 0, 
                         na.value = "lightgrey") +
    labs(title = "Seasonal Forecast: Rainfall Anomaly",
         fill = "Rainfall Anomaly") +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, "cm"),
          text = element_text(size = 20))

```

An ENSO-neutral phase and a positive IOD phase will characterise the upcoming season. This would result in increased rainfall.

## Historical Context and Rainfall Distribution

What the seasonal forecast shows with respect to historical years

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#| label: fig-historical
#| fig-cap: 
#|   - "Seasonal rainfall over the Kiremt-receiving woredas"
#|   - "2024 Forecast vs Rainfall Distribution"
#| column: page-inset-right
#| layout-nrow: 1
#| out-width: "100%"

forecast_mean %>%
    merge(jjas_forecast, by = "adm3_pcode") %>%
    filter(adm3_pcode %in% jjas_woredas$admin3Pcode) %>%
    mutate(Anomaly = Seasonal_total - Seasonal_average) %>%
    group_by(pub_year) %>%
    summarise(country_mean = mean(Seasonal_total, na.rm=T)) %>%
    bind_rows(ave_2024) %>%
    mutate(cur_season = if_else(pub_year == 2024, "Yes", "No")) %>%
    ggplot() +
    geom_line(aes(x = pub_year, y = country_mean), color = "#0f52ba",
              linewidth = 0.8) + 
    geom_point(data = ave_2024, aes(x = pub_year,
                                    y = country_mean,
                                    color = "Yes"), size = 5) +  
    labs(title = "Seasonal Rainfall over the years",
         x = "Year",
         y = "Rainfall (mm)") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = ave_2024$country_mean, 
               color = "tomato", linewidth = 1, 
               linetype = "dashed") +
    annotate("text", x = 2005, y = ave_2024$country_mean, 
                  label = "Forecast Average", color = "black", 
             vjust = -0.5, size = 7) +
    annotate("text", x = 2024, y = ave_2024$country_mean, 
             label = "2024", color = "black", 
             vjust = -0.8, hjust = -0.1, size = 7) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Yes" = "orange")) + 
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = date_breaks(width = 5)) + 
    xlim(1980, 2030) +
    guides(linewidth = "none", color = "none")+
    theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, "cm"),
          text = element_text(size = 20))


df <- forecast_mean %>%
    merge(jjas_forecast, by = "adm3_pcode") %>%
    filter(adm3_pcode %in% jjas_woredas$admin3Pcode) %>%
    mutate(Anomaly = Seasonal_total - Seasonal_average) %>%
    group_by(pub_year) %>%
    summarise(country_mean = mean(Seasonal_total, na.rm=T)) %>%
    bind_rows(ave_2024) %>%
    mutate(cur_season = if_else(pub_year == 2024, "Yes", "No"))

# Calculate percentiles
percentiles <- quantile(df$country_mean, probs = c(0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1))

# Bin the years according to percentiles
df$percentile <- cut(df$country_mean, breaks = c(-Inf, percentiles), 
                     labels = c("20%", "40%", "60%", "80%", "100%"), include.lowest = TRUE)

# Aggregate years within each bin
label_data <- df %>%
    group_by(percentile) %>%
    summarise(years = paste(unique(pub_year), collapse = "\n"))  # Concatenate years with newline character

# Calculate midpoint of each bin
bin_midpoints <- c(0, percentiles[-length(percentiles)] + diff(percentiles) / 2)

# Ensure bin_midpoints matches the number of bins
bin_midpoints <- bin_midpoints[1:nrow(label_data)]
bin_midpoints[1] <- 800

# Repeat the midpoint for each label
label_data$x <- bin_midpoints
label_data$y <- rep(0, nrow(label_data))

# Plotting
ggplot(df, aes(x = country_mean)) +
    geom_density(fill = "skyblue", alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 1.2) +  # Increase line width
    geom_text(data = label_data,
              aes(label = years, x = x, y = y),  # Position text near the middle of each bin
              hjust = 0.5, vjust = -0.2, size = 5.5, color = "black") +  # Adjust justification and size
    geom_vline(xintercept = percentiles, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = ave_2024$country_mean, color = "red", linewidth = 1.2) + # Add vertical lines at percentiles
    labs(title = "Density Plot with Years by Percentile with 2024 highlighted",
         y = "Density", x = "Rainfall (mm)") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
          plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, "cm"),
          text = element_text(size = 20))  # Remove y-axis labels

```

### Return Period by Zone

The table describes the non-exceedance probability, indicating how often a season would historically have had a value that is less than or equal to the 2024 seasonal value. For example, the East Gojam Zone in Amhara Region expects to receive on average, a season with rainfall less than or equal to 1150 mm once every 43 years, a rare event.

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#| label: fig-returnperiod
#| fig-cap: 
#|   - "Return Periods for the 2024 forecast by Zone"
#| column: page-inset-right
#| layout-nrow: 1
#| out-width: "100%"

all_forecasts <- may_forecast %>%
    filter(admin3Pcode %in% jjas_woredas$admin3Pcode) %>%
    dplyr::select(admin3Pcode, Seasonal_Forecast) %>%
    mutate(pub_year = 2024) %>%
    bind_rows(jjas_forecast %>%
                  ungroup() %>%
                  dplyr::select(adm3_pcode, Seasonal_total, pub_year) %>%
                  rename(admin3Pcode=adm3_pcode,Seasonal_Forecast=Seasonal_total)) %>%
    mutate(admin2Pcode = substr(admin3Pcode, 1, 6)) %>%
    group_by(admin2Pcode, pub_year) %>%
    summarise(Zonal_Mean = round(mean(Seasonal_Forecast, na.rm = T), 2)) %>%
    group_by(admin2Pcode) %>%
    mutate(ecdf_values = ecdf(Zonal_Mean)(Zonal_Mean),
           non_exceedance_probability = ecdf_values,
           non_exceedance_probability = replace(non_exceedance_probability, non_exceedance_probability == 0, 1e-10),
           return_period = round(1 / non_exceedance_probability, 1),
           Zonal_Mean = format(Zonal_Mean, big.mark=",", 
                               scientific=FALSE)) %>%
    merge(eth_adm2_codab, by = "admin2Pcode") %>%
    filter(pub_year == 2024) %>%
    dplyr::select(admin2Name_en, admin1Name_en, Zonal_Mean, return_period) %>%
    rename(`Zone Name` = admin2Name_en,
           `Region Name` = admin1Name_en,
           `Seasonal Forecast` = Zonal_Mean,
           `Return Period` = return_period)

DT::datatable(all_forecasts,
              rownames = F,
              class = "compact row-border",
              options = list(
                  filter = "none",
                  dom = "tpi",
                  columnDefs = list(
                      list(
                          className = 'dt-right', 
                          targets="_all")))) %>%
    formatStyle(columns = c("Zone Name", "Region Name", "Seasonal Forecast"), textAlign = "right")

```

## Similar years and Expected Impact

These are the years that had the closest absolute seasonal rainfall to the 2024 forecast.

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#| label: fig-impact
#| fig-cap: 
#|   - "Years with Seasonal Rainfall similar to the 2024 forecast"
#| column: page-inset-right
#| layout-ncol: 1
#| out-width: "100%"
#| #datatable {border-collapse: collapse; border-spacing: 0;}
#| #datatable th, #datatable td {border: 1px solid #dddddd;padding: 8px;}
#| #datatable th {background-color: #f2f2f2;}

impact_forecasts <- may_forecast %>%
    filter(admin3Pcode %in% jjas_woredas$admin3Pcode) %>%
    dplyr::select(admin3Pcode, Seasonal_Forecast) %>%
    mutate(pub_year = 2024) %>%
    bind_rows(jjas_forecast %>%
                  ungroup() %>%
                  dplyr::select(adm3_pcode, Seasonal_total, pub_year) %>%
                  rename(admin3Pcode=adm3_pcode,Seasonal_Forecast=Seasonal_total)) %>%
    group_by(pub_year) %>%
    summarise(Seasonal_Mean = round(mean(Seasonal_Forecast, na.rm = T), 2))

# Specify the target year
target_year <- 2024

# Get the rainfall value for the target year
target_rainfall <- impact_forecasts %>% 
    filter(pub_year == target_year) %>% 
    pull(Seasonal_Mean)

# Calculate the 10% range
lower_bound <- target_rainfall * 0.9
upper_bound <- target_rainfall * 1.1

# adding em_dat and cerf data
eth_emdat <- em_dat %>%
    filter(ISO == "ETH" & `Disaster Type` == "Drought") %>%
    dplyr::select(`Start Year`, `End Year`, `Total Affected`) %>%
    mutate(`Total Affected` = format(`Total Affected`, 
                                          big.mark=",", 
                                          scientific=FALSE))

eth_cerf <- funding %>%
    filter(`Emergency type` == "Drought") %>%
    mutate(Year = year(`Approval date`)) %>%
    group_by(Year) %>%
    summarise(`Approved CERF Allocation` = sum(`Approved amount in US$`, na.rm = T)) %>%
    mutate(`Approved CERF Allocation` = format(`Approved CERF Allocation`, big.mark=",", scientific=FALSE))

# Filter the data for years within the 10% range
similar_years <- impact_forecasts %>%
    filter(Seasonal_Mean >= lower_bound & Seasonal_Mean <= upper_bound) %>%
    mutate(
        Difference = round(abs(Seasonal_Mean - target_rainfall), 1)
    ) %>%
    arrange(Difference) %>%
    rename(Year = pub_year, 
           `Seasonal Rainfall` = Seasonal_Mean) %>%
    merge(eth_cerf, by = "Year", all = TRUE, sort = FALSE) %>%
    merge(eth_emdat, by.x = "Year", by.y = "Start Year", all = TRUE, sort = FALSE) %>%
    arrange(Difference) %>%
    # Replace NA values with empty strings
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), "", .)))
    
similar_years %>%
    mutate(
        cleaned_cerf = as.numeric(gsub(",", "", `Approved CERF Allocation`)) / 1000000,
        formatted_cerf = ifelse(is.na(cleaned_cerf), "", paste0(round(cleaned_cerf, 1), "M")),
        ave_drought_yr = as.integer((Year + as.integer(`End Year`) ) / 2),
        `End Year` = factor(`End Year`),
        cleaned_emdat = as.numeric(gsub(",", "", `Total Affected`)) / 40000,
        formatted_emdat = ifelse(is.na(cleaned_emdat), "", paste0(round(cleaned_emdat*0.04, 1), "M"))
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=factor(Year), y=as.numeric(`Seasonal Rainfall`))) +
    geom_bar(stat="identity", fill="#0F52BA") +
    geom_text(aes(label=(gsub(",", "", formatted_cerf))), vjust=-0.5, color="black") +
    labs(title="Total Rainfall of Similar Seasons and CERF Allocations by Year",
         subtitle = "People affected by drought for each Drought Period",
         x="Year", y="Seasonal Rainfall (mm)") +
    scale_x_discrete(breaks = seq(1981, 2024, by = 6)) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = factor(Year), xmax = factor(`End Year`),
                  ymin = 0, ymax = cleaned_emdat), fill = "tomato", alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_text(aes(x = factor(ave_drought_yr), 
                  y = cleaned_emdat,
                  label=(gsub(",", "", formatted_emdat))), vjust=-0.5, hjust=0.2, color="black")


# Display the result in a datatable
DT::datatable(similar_years,
              rownames = F,
              class = "compact row-border",
              options = list(
                  filter = "none",
                  dom = "tpi",
                  columnDefs = list(
                      list(
                          className = 'dt-right', 
                          targets="_all")))) %>%
    formatStyle(c("Seasonal Rainfall", "Difference", "Approved CERF Allocation"), textAlign = "right")

```
